summary.text: Tony Bacala is a Republican member of the Louisiana House of Representatives for District 59, which covers Ascension Parish, and was first elected in 2015. His official House page lists him as Chair of the Ways and Means Committee and Chair of the Capitol Security Council.

paragraphs.text: The House page lists Bacala's occupation as retired chief deputy of the Ascension Parish Sheriff's Office.
It lists his education as a bachelor's degree from Louisiana State University in 1982 and the FBI National Academy in 2004.
He is also listed as a member of the Joint Legislative Committee on the Budget, the Joint Legislative Committee on Capital Outlay and the State Bond Commission.
